_note: Simulated retired expert used to demo the interview agent. In the demo you can type these answers live, or the app can play them back.

answers.question_hint: Why is MAT-7730 excluded from automatic reorder?
answers.answer: Yes, that is related. MAT-7730 is a speciality alloy and the supplier put it on allocation in 2022. They only accept scheduled call-offs, and every automatic purchase order they reject costs us a cancellation penalty under the contract. After the rejections in June 2022 I excluded it from auto-reorder so the planner raises call-offs by hand. Do not switch it back unless procurement renegotiates the contract, otherwise the penalties start again.
answers.risk_if_removed: high, supplier penalties on every rejected order

answers.question_hint: Why is negative stock allowed in storage location SL-09?
answers.answer: SL-09 is the customer returns bay at Hosur. Returned goods are often re-shipped before the returns paperwork is posted, and without negative stock the system blocked those shipments. I allowed negative stock only for SL-09 in August 2020 as a workaround. Stores reconcile it every Friday. If you remove it, re-shipments from the returns bay will block until the returns process is fixed.

answers.question_hint: Why is the slow-moving threshold 365 days when policy says 180?
answers.answer: In November 2020 the plants had been running at half capacity for months, so almost everything looked slow-moving at 180 days. Planners were getting lists of three thousand items and ignoring them. I moved it to 365 days to make the list usable during COVID. It was meant to go back to 180 once volumes recovered. Nobody asked, so it stayed.
answers.risk_if_removed: none; reverting to 180 restores policy compliance
